user_brief: Washington DC'deki gayrimenkul yatırım fırsatlarını Türkiye'deki yatırımcılara anlatan çarpıcı bir Instagram postu hazırla. Amerikan renklerini kullan.

classification.color_direction: Amerikan paleti: navy, cream, restrained red accent — luxury editorial, not a flag collage

design_direction.hierarchy: One dominant read in the first 2 seconds; secondary lines quieter; CTA actionable; logo present once.
design_direction.composition_direction: Şehir manzarası ön planda, logo ve mesajlar dengeli yerleştirilmiş
design_direction.image_treatment: Use the locked city/place photograph. Do not treat it as project architecture. Do not invent The Temple or any selected-project building.
design_direction.contrast: High readability for primary message and CTA against the locked photograph
design_direction.brand_presence: One verified Investhome company logo lockup — never invent or duplicate
design_direction.cta_importance: Single clear CTA; visible and actionable, not tiny footer text
design_direction.creative_freedom: Language=tr. BRAND/MARKET AD — no project interior lock, no project exterior lock, no project architecture constraints. Do not inherit the selected project's creative direction. Use Investhome brand rules, market/location direction, requested visual type, and approved company assets only.
